ustawienia.podtytul: Settings are stored in a config file on this computer.
ustawienia.rownolegle.pomoc: More = faster for many small files, but each one is slower.
ustawienia.narzedzia.pomoc: SoraFlux uses ffmpeg, ffprobe, yt-dlp and Deno, plus whisper.cpp for subtitles. They are not bundled: they are detected on your system, picked by you or downloaded from official sources (SHA256 verified). Downloads go to:
ustawienia.enkodery.brak_sprzetu: No working hardware encoders found (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF). CPU encoding always works.
ustawienia.prywatnosc.opis: Zero telemetry. Files never leave your computer. SoraFlux only goes online when you ask: downloading tools, updating yt-dlp, downloading videos and their thumbnails, downloading the speech model for subtitles (with your consent).
narzedzia.menedzer: Install with your package manager (e.g. sudo apt install ffmpeg)
kreator.opis: SoraFlux needs a few free tools. What you already have was detected; get the rest with one click.
kreator.zrodla: Downloads come only from official releases (ffmpeg: gyan.dev “release essentials”, yt-dlp and Deno: GitHub), with SHA256 verification.
panel.dziesiec_bit.opis: Smoother gradients, but many phones and messengers won't play it
panel.dziesiec_bit.hdr: Keep HDR (10-bit, no conversion to SDR)
podpowiedz.hdr_na_sdr: The video is HDR: colors will be converted to standard range (SDR) so they don't look washed out on phones and in messengers.
podpowiedz.hdr_bez_tonemapowania: The video is HDR and this ffmpeg lacks the zscale filter: colors may look washed out. Get ffmpeg from gyan.dev in Settings.
podpowiedz.dziesiec_bit: 10-bit output: not every phone or messenger will play it.
podpowiedz.dziesiec_bit_hdr: Output stays HDR (10-bit). Colors may look different on non-HDR screens.
podpowiedz.dziesiec_bit_niedostepne: H.264 and MPEG-4 are written in 8-bit (almost nothing plays 10-bit H.264). Pick H.265 or AV1 for 10-bit.
podpowiedz.mp4_opus: Opus in MP4 works in browsers and VLC, but older players and phones may not play it. AAC is the safest choice.
podpowiedz.napisy_pominiete: Image-based subtitles (PGS/VobSub) don't fit this format: {n} skipped. MKV keeps them.
podpowiedz.napisy_nieobslugiwane: This format doesn't take subtitles: they will be skipped.
podpowiedz.ciecie_klatka_kluczowa: Cutting without re-encoding is instant, but starts at the nearest earlier keyframe: with rare keyframes the result can be several seconds longer. Frame-accurate: “Accurate (re-encode)”.
kolejka.awaria_sprzetu: The hardware encoder failed, finished on the CPU.
ustawienia.rownolegle_wideo.pomoc: Video is heavy on the CPU: 1 is safest. Images don't count.
ustawienia.priorytet.opis: Convert at lower priority: a bit slower, but the computer stays smooth
ustawienia.przenosny: Portable mode: settings, presets and tools live in the “portable” folder next to the program.
aktualizacje.jest: Version {wersja} is available. Download and install now?
aktualizacje.blad: Couldn't check for updates ({blad}). You can download the new version from the releases page.
raport.opis: The report holds versions, system and recent errors, without your folder paths. Nothing is sent: you paste it wherever you want.
akcje.wytnij.pomoc: Set from–to. Without re-encoding the cut takes seconds and keeps full quality, but starts at the nearest earlier keyframe: in files with rare keyframes the result can be several seconds longer (we check the length afterwards and warn you). Frame-accurate: turn on “Accurate”.
akcje.wytnij.pomoc_dokladnie: Set from–to. “Accurate” re-encodes the clip: frame-accurate, but it takes longer (like a normal conversion).
foldery.struktura.obok: Results go next to the source files anyway. Matters when you pick an output folder.

narzedzia2.kontener.pomoc: Picture, sound and subtitles are copied as they are. If a codec doesn't fit the container, I'll skip the file and say why.
narzedzia2.sciezki.opis: Sound, picture and subtitles into separate files

narzedzia2.glosnosc.opis: EBU R128 in two passes, picture not re-encoded
narzedzia2.glosnosc.pomoc: First the whole recording is measured, then one even shift (no “pumping”). Picture is copied.
